analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly revenue and robust profit growth for Q2 and H1 FY27, supported by elevated gross margin spreads and disciplined sourcing despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and shipping disruptions in West Asia. The company's total installed capacity on a consolidated basis stands at 838,637 kiloliters, following the capitalization of capital WIP from Indian plants. Management highlighted steady demand in the Process and Insulating Oil (PIO) and pharmaceutical sectors, while export volumes and operations at the UAE subsidiary faced temporary headwinds. The company remains focused on deepening segment presence, expanding capacity, and protecting margins through optimized sourcing strategies. Management reported its highest-ever quarterly performance for Q2 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹1,847 crore and profit after tax standing at ₹186 crore, driven by sourcing agility, disciplined procurement, and product mix.

guidance.claim: Management remains optimistic about sustaining current gross margins and spreads in the upcoming third and fourth quarters.
guidance.quote: We will continue -- we are quite optimistic and quite positive in achieving this run rate even for the quarters to come, Q3 and Q4, we are quite optimistic.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at the current level or around this level for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

guidance.claim: The company targets volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11% during the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that export revenue and export sales will remain at the same level for the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that growth trends in the PHPO and process and insulating oil segments will continue to be similar for the next quarters.
guidance.quote: So, these are the two segments where we anticipate the growth will be similar. The trend will continue to be similar for the next quarters as well.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that margins will continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
guidance.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO segment experienced healthy demand driven by transformers, power, and the rubber industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volumes moderated during the quarter due to geopolitical developments in West Asia and impacts on shipping and logistics.
demand_outlook.quote: However, export volume had moderated during this quarter, primarily due to the geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on the shipping and logistics.

demand_outlook.claim: There continues to be a gap between the demand and supply of base oil because of refinery closures and vessel disruptions.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, there is a supply gap because of refinery closures because of vessel disruption. So, there continues to be a gap between the demand and the supply.

demand_outlook.claim: The company saw strong traction in PIO, supported by demand from the transformer, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance during the quarter was driven by a healthy demand environment across key end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Our performance during this quarter was driven by a healthy demand environment across our key end-user industries, coupled with disciplined execution across the businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business grew 28% year-on-year supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the transformer oil category will have strong and robust growth for the future and quarters to come due to increasing electricity requirements globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Thanks to the increasing requirement of electricity, not only in India, but globally; we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity on a consolidated basis stands at 838,637 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity at Indian plants stands at 602,713 kiloliters following capital WIP capitalization over the last 1.5 to 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Having enumerated the same, our installed capacity for the Indian plants now stood at 602,713.

capex_expansion.claim: The total installed capacity increased by an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing 598,000 capacity due to capital WIP capitalization.
capex_expansion.quote: the total installed capacity now stands at 838,000 which is an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing capacity of 5,98,000, which is basically on account of the capitalization over the last few quarters of the capital WIP.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter stood at 21% with a spread of approximately INR29,128 per kl.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%. The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: A one-time ex gratia payment of INR15 crores to INR16 crores was paid across the board to employees, impacting employee expenses.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: Insurance rates and war risk premiums for vessels coming out of Hormuz have increased.
margins_costs.quote: Insurance rates have gone up ma'am.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the quarter on a consolidated level was 21.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Stand-alone plant capacity utilization is currently around 82%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, I can tell you currently, currently the utilization on stand-alone level is 80%, 82% to be precise.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated level capacity utilization is approximately 61%.
orders_capacity.quote: The consol level, it is around 61%.

orders_capacity.claim: First half volume growth for the Process and Insulating Oil (PIO) segment grew 23% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: This business continued to deliver a very strong performance with H1 volume growing 23% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: PIO manufacturing volumes went up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
orders_capacity.quote: But on a consolidated basis, Vinit, the PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization across all 3 plants taken together is around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

capital_allocation.quote: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR85 crores as of September 30, 2026, down from INR168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL enhanced rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: The reaffirmation of our credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of our rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore further strengthen our financial flexibility.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of the share.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains effectively debt-free on a stand-alone basis.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to use about INR 20 crores of the quarter's performance for the payment of an interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing tensions in West Asia and disruptions to global shipping routes continue to create a challenging operating environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Silvassa unit 2 experienced heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July, resulting in an inventory and operational loss.
risks_headwinds.quote: As shared earlier, our Silvassa unit 2 was affected by a heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory and contamination loss along with expenses of approximately INR21 crores, recognized as an exceptional item.
risks_headwinds.quote: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores. As this is a onetime event, we have presented it as an exceptional item.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment remained challenging due to heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East and concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at subsidiary Texol were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on deepening presence across segments, expanding into new geographies, moving into higher value chain, and expanding capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Moving ahead, our priorities remain clear: deepen our presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain and expand capacity.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to funding growth capex largely through internal accruals and maintaining a prudent balance sheet.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding presence across geographies, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at the current level or around this level for the whole year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11% during the year.
management_commitments.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that export revenue and export sales will remain at the same level for the quarters to come.
management_commitments.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
